name: Set membership over an accredited root

request.need: the membership leg every DTG proof stands on (VMC from a VTC in the verifier's anchor set) · alias: issuer-as-predicate (ScottJeezey, cred-tf #39 2026-08-25) — prove an issuer belongs to an accredited set rather than naming it, because the observer is often a venue or event and therefore the most identifying element

dish: A verifier learns that the holder's credential commitment is a leaf of a published membership root, without learning which leaf.
ingredients: membership credential secret / commitment preimage (the VMC leaf)
Merkle path (depth 20 ≈ 1M leaves) and path indices
pantry: root — the accredited/membership root the verifier recognises (registry state)

method.clause: the committed leaf is in the tree at `root`

doesNotEstablish: that the community's admission decision was correct (assurance boundary)
that the leaf is current (see card 006)

adversary.claim: leaf hidden from the registry operator only if the root is fetched without a per-holder query

substitutions.cost: 11,522 constraints · ~680 ms prove · ~8 ms verify · 721 B (with card 003 bound)

substitutions.route: Flock-class binary-field prover over a standard-hash (BLAKE3 or SHA-256) Merkle tree — the path is a batch of compressions, Flock’s native workload; removes the Poseidon requirement on the registry side and gives a post-quantum path (LIV-ALG-07)
substitutions.cost: unmeasured — conjecture: depth-20 path ≈ 20–40 compressions ≈ well under a millisecond of prover work per the published 82,100 compressions/s single-core figure; proof size in the hundreds of kB class

issuance: issuer publishes a ZK-friendly commitment per member (Poseidon leaf) or an accumulator

spec: cred-tf #39 (ScottJeezey 2026-08-25): issuer-as-predicate named as a ZKP TF work item — this card
